description.value: Timberlane Track is a City of Powell River outdoor sports facility perched high above Townsite, offering panoramic views of the Salish Sea and the surrounding BC coast. It is home to the Villa Soccer Club and hosts a full-sized soccer pitch as well as a 400-metre walking and running track. The dramatic coastal setting makes it a potentially scenic stop for touring cyclists exploring the Powell River area.

address.value: 5400 Timberlane Ave, Powell River, BC V8A 5M8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record tags this as a sports_centre named 'Timberlane Park,' but the website's Sports Fields page refers to it as 'Timberlane Track' at 5400 Timberlane Ave. The website describes it as a full-sized soccer pitch and 400-metre running/walking track with coastal views, but provides no specific detail about bike parking, washrooms, water access, or other cycling amenities. All amenity fields are set to null due to absence of evidence; the name discrepancy between OSM and the website is flagged in concerns.

A site visit or direct contact with Powell River Parks would be needed to verify whether the facility meets WWC inclusion criteria.
